To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the epithelium of the human palatin tonsil is reticularised from the 18th prenatal week, the reticularisation is preceded by the formation of the basal membrane and the reticularised areas are the sites of lymphocyte migration.

the reticularisation of the tonsillar surface epithelium starts at 16th week of gestation and is completed by 40th week, and that it is a complex process involving the epithelial basal lamina, the epithelial cells, the intraepithelium and the lymphatic cells.

the process of the reticularisation of the epithelium is a very important phenomenon of the development of the tonsillar epithelium.

the epithelial reticularisation is the first step of the tonsillar lymphoepithelial complex development.
